content: FAA FACT3 (Airport Capacity Needs in the NAS) and FAA Capacity Analysis define runway capacity via hourly throughput sustainable at high demand; 27 airports flagged as constrained or at risk by 2033. Unmet/suppressed demand not given a single crisp FAA formula in public search results — closest operational proxy is slot-controlled airport caps (demand capped below willingness-to-fly) and declared-capacity vs scheduled-demand gap.
